title: RigContract
description: Named socket/anchor attachment contract for a 2D sprite rig. Defines per-angle offsets for each socket type and the compiler-owned layer ordering.

rig_definition_id.description: Stable identifier for this rig contract (e.g. 'wolfie_crossbow_v1').

description.description: Human-readable description of this rig contract.

version.description: Schema version for this contract. Bump when adding new socket types.

sockets.description: Per-socket attachment definitions, keyed by socket name.

layer_order.description: Compiler-owned layer render sequence. Runtime applies this order verbatim.

angle_offsets.description: Per-angle dx/dy offsets. Must have exactly 8 entries (angles 0-7).

visibility.description: 'always' means visible at all angles. 'angle_range' means only visible at angles listed in visible_angles.

visible_angles.description: Required when visibility is 'angle_range'. Lists the angle indices where this socket is visible.

dx.description: Horizontal offset in XP cell space.

dy.description: Vertical offset in XP cell space.
